line: Offer your seat to someone who needs it more.
paragraph: Liu Peijin and his wife married out of high school and dreamed of a grand tour around China. He spent years in the military while she raised their children at home. When she became paralyzed, he did not put her in a hospital bed to stay. He put her in their vehicle and drove. They have been on the road ever since.

seed.summary: Like any pair of baby boomers in America, Liu Peijin and his wife dreamed as newly-weds of a grand tour around their native China.
